snippet.title: Islands & Trains - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
➤ ISLANDS & TRAINS on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1957760/Islands__Trains/

Islands & Trains is a loveletter to building little toy train dioramas in our childhood.
It will be out on May 29th, so you can become a train conductor and builder of your own little worlds in our minimalist building game really soon !

If you’re thinking about buying ISLANDS & TRAINS, please keep in mind that we are a very passionate but small team of just 2 people. So any support from you means the world to us :)

#indiegame #trailer #wholesomegames #trains
